links.comparator_used: Single-input risk models: clinical-only CHARGE-AF score and 12-lead ECG-only AI model (ECG-AI)
links.outcome: Two-year incident AF discrimination (time-dependent AUROC and average precision)
links.effect: AUROC: CH-AI (ECG-AI + clinical) 0.788 (95% CI 0.754-0.824) vs ECG-AI 0.784 (0.743-0.819) vs CHARGE-AF 0.711 (0.671-0.749). Average precision: 0.133 vs 0.132 vs 0.0952. The combined model clearly beat clinical-only but was nearly identical to ECG-AI alone.

design_hint: risk-based targeting of screening using AI-ECG risk thresholds
